data.long_meaning: Bhashini is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhasha' which means speech. This name is a tribute to the Goddess of Speech and Learning, Saraswati. It is believed that a child named Bhashini will be blessed with the gift of eloquent speech and a sharp mind. The name Bhashini carries the meaning “Goddess of Speech” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Bhashini usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of speech and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bhashini is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is a name that honors the Goddess Saraswati, who is revered as the embodiment of knowledge, wisdom, and speech. A name like Bhashini is believed to bestow the child with the blessings of Saraswati, and instill in them a deep love for learning and knowledge.
